Dave Matthews Band
9 May 2023
Auditorio Nacional - Mexico City, MEX

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Front Stage Left Corner of FOH, DFC, Mics PAS @ 7'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.79 (Gain, Mixing/Post Processing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.3.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

12. #41
13. Band Introductions
14. Grey Street
15. Dave Speak: Demasiado para beber/Ciudad de México amor
16. Busted Stuff
17. The Space Between
18. Louisiana Bayou
19. Crash into Me²
20. Monsters³
21. Why I Am 
22. You & Me⁴
23. Warehouse⁵
24. Encore Break
25. Dave Speak: Looking for a Vein Intro
26. Looking for a Vein⁶
27. Don't Drink the Water⁷

Set Time: [02:33:55.013]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ Dave album intro vocals; extended outro
² Dixie Chicken interpolation
³ Full Band Debut
⁴ includes Hope for Tomorrow prelude
⁵ Improv and stop-time intros
⁶ Song Debut
⁷ includes prelude with Forty Six & 2 interpolation

Rashawn teases "Feels So Good" by Chuck Mangione between Jimi Thing and Bismarck.

During "Louisiana Bayou", Dave's guitar pack has a malfunction that causes the band to lose track of where they are in the song.

My undying gratitude to Red Light Management for making this recording possible.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2023/05/10.
